fig_cat_placed.intent: Same plush now on folded cloth, hands released; canonical shield/chair/table remain.

fig_bond_end.intent: Standing empty-handed by same chair, foreground desk remains with closed folder and blank sheet.

fig_bond_table.intent: Lantern resting center of same desk; two tea cups; invitation, relaxed face.

fig_bond_paper.intent: Pulling blank sheet toward herself, no cup held; lantern stays on desk.

fig_bond_hover.intent: Pen hovering over sheet, other hand tucks loose hair; lantern stays on desk.

fig_bond_write.intent: Pen tip contacts sheet, other hand steadies paper; lantern stays on desk.

fig_bond_present.intent: Actually holds and presents the written page toward player; lantern stays on desk.

fig_bond_return.intent: Receives returned written sheet, holding edge carefully above desk; lantern stays on desk.

fig_bond_store.intent: Slides written page into same lower drawer; lantern stays on desk.

fig_bond_neutral.intent: Same lectern persists while she holds book and pauses page turn.

fig_bond_adjust.intent: Same lectern persists during empty-hand glasses adjustment.

fig_bond_soft.intent: Same lectern persists, book placed on it, personal note visible; softened gaze.

fig_bond_page.intent: Same lectern persists, personal note slips between pages.

fig_bond_hidden.intent: Same lectern persists while book conceals mouth; eyes visible.
